node.title: Re: IO::Socket::SSL / Net::SSLeay inefficient in non-blocking mode ?
node.author: haukex
node.doctext: I unfortunately can't comment on the low-level issue you're experiencing here, all I can say is that nowadays, I would not implement this kind of thing on such a low level, and use some event loop framework like [mod://POE] or [mod://Mojo::IOLoop] instead. I showed an example of a simple TCP client/server [id://11113259|here], you should be able to extend that by adding the appropriate tls options. Perhaps using such a ready-made higher-level framework will help you avoid this low-level issue.
